Adoption of the draft report on Clean Corporate Vehicles (together with TRAN)
During their meeting on 4 November, the ENVI and TRAN Committees voted on the draft report "Clean corporate vehicles".
This proposal for a new Regulation, which sets national level targets for the share of zero- and low-emission vehicles in the fleets of large undertakings, offers an additional tool in the decarbonisation of the transport sector by making steps towards greening corporate fleets, which by their nature and specifics have significant potential to support and accelerate the uptake of zero- and low-emission vehicles.
The report adopted jointly by the Environment, Climate and Food Safety (ENVI) and the Committees on Transport and Tourism (TRAN) maintains the Commission’s approach, however, changes the nature of the targets to aspirational rather than binding with a new set of exclusions from the scope of the Regulation for certain categories of specialised vehicles. It also builds on the specifics of the national plans that Member States should put in place to stimulate the greening of corporate fleets and further provides for the adoption by the Commission of Union guidelines on best practices.
